title: How Seniors Are Outsmarting Clever Phone Scams
description:
Scammers are increasingly targeting older adults, but local communities are fighting back.

Local safety seminars are equipping seniors with simple tools to recognize warning signs before financial harm occurs. Attendees learn practical steps—such as ignoring unknown callers, questioning suspicious healthcare representatives, and hanging up when something doesn’t feel right—to help protect their personal information and savings.

Community members emphasize that spending just a little time at these interactive workshops can provide tremendous peace of mind. By staying informed and alert, older adults can outsmart scammers and protect their hard-earned savings.
